subject: State sync gap — RCA draft and request for your verification
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@blueharbor.com>, ops@blueharbor.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: State sync gap — initial incident summary and next steps

Hi Lena / BlueHarbor ops team,

Thanks for the patience this morning — I wanted to get a short, factual note in your inbox while our teams finish the post-incident write-up.

What happened (brief):
- Between ~02:14:10 and 02:19:05 UTC we observed a short state synchronization gap across a subset of inference replicas serving your dedicated pool.
- The gap caused 502 and 504 errors for longest-context requests and a small number of request retries. Estimated affected request rate: ~0.6% of requests to your pool during the window.

Immediate status:
- Root cause investigation in progress; we have a draft RCA attached (rca_draft_state-sync-20261123.pdf) and a token-level snapshot describing the observed divergence (token_snapshot_20261123.csv).
- We are not seeing any evidence of data exfiltration; this is a durability/consistency alignment issue.

Next steps we are taking now:
1) Finalize RCA with timeline & contributing factors (target ETA: today, EOD PST).
2) Apply a short-term guard (sticky sync verification) to prevent the same window-of-misalignment on that pool.
3) Share verification checklist and run a joint replay with your ops team if you’d like (we can coordinate times).

Can you confirm the impact you observed on your side (errors, client retries, any user-facing incidents)? If you want, attach a short log sample or a link to the internal ticket and we’ll correlate.

I’ll follow up with the full timeline and concrete action items once the team completes the write-up.

Apologies for the disruption — we’re treating this as high priority.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0113
From: Lena Park <lena@blueharbor.com>

Subject: Re: State sync gap — initial incident summary and next steps

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the quick note.

What we saw: from 02:15–02:20 UTC our transaction service logged increased 502s for long-context calls and our customer-facing retry logic triggered about ~0.9% more retries in that window. No customer data appears to have been lost, but we did surface a small spike in error rates on the dashboard.

For correlation: I’ve attached a brief log excerpt to our ticket (internal link to Ticket BH-3419) and I can send a longer trace if needed. Two questions:
1) Will Redwood trigger an SLA credit for the affected window?
2) Can you provide the full timeline and the verification checklist so we can validate on our side?

We’d like to schedule a 30-minute replay/verification session tomorrow morning if possible (PST).

— Lena
Lena Park
Head of SRE, BlueHarbor Payments

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800

Rafael / team — quick internal note while I review the draft:
- Prioritize producing a concise customer-facing RCA (one-page executive summary + technical appendix).
- Include these action owners and proposed mitigations:
  * short-term: enable sticky-sync verification for BlueHarbor pool (owner: infra-runbook, ETA: 24h)
  * mid-term: snapshot persistence for token index + 24h retention to aid reconciliation (owner: storage-team, ETA: 2 weeks)
  * long-term: active replica cross-check on sequence advance and automated rollback policy (owner: runtime, ETA: 8 weeks)
- Add a clear verification plan for BlueHarbor: log correlation points, sample ids, and an optional replay window.
- For SLAs/credits escalate to finance after RCA is accepted by both sides; hook in Alex Martinez for approval path.

I’ll review the draft and drop comments in the shared Drive doc. Rafael — propose we give BlueHarbor the verification checklist in the next mail and offer tomorrow 09:30–10:00 PST for a replay.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@blueharbor.com>, ops@blueharbor.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: State sync gap — final RCA, timeline, and verification checklist

Lena / BlueHarbor ops,

Thank you for the confirmation and for the log excerpt — that helped accelerate correlation. Attached are three artifacts: the customer-facing RCA (rca_draft_state-sync-20261123.pdf), the token snapshot we used to verify divergence (token_snapshot_20261123.csv), and a short verification checklist with recommended replay steps (verification_checklist_20261123.md).

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Impact window: 2026-11-23 02:14:10 UTC → 2026-11-23 02:19:05 UTC. Estimated affected requests: ~0.6–0.9% of BlueHarbor production requests handled by the dedicated pool. No data exfiltration identified.

Root cause (short):
- A state-sync coordination message failed to propagate to one replica due to a transient message-broker partition combined with an in-flight KV compaction job. The compaction job evicted a small set of recently written token indices before the delayed coordination message arrived, causing a transient divergence when the replica served a long-context request.

Contributing factors:
- Coordination message lacked redundant delivery paths for the compaction window.
- Compaction window coincided with higher-than-normal background IO on that host.

Actions committed (owner / ETA):
1) Sticky-sync verification: add a pre-serve check for sequence alignment on long-context requests (owner: runtime; ETA: 24 hours).
2) Snapshot persistence: persist token index snapshot for 24 hours post-write to enable reconciliation (owner: storage; ETA: 2 weeks).
3) Broker resilience: add redundant delivery and retry logic for coordination messages (owner: infra/messaging; ETA: 3 weeks).
4) Post-deployment verification: automated nightly cross-check for pool replicas and an alert if divergence > 0.01% (owner: reliability; ETA: 4 weeks).

Planned verification with BlueHarbor:
- We propose a 30-minute joint replay and verification tomorrow 2026-11-24 at 09:30 PST. Steps are in verification_checklist_20261123.md (filters, sample ids, expected signatures). Please confirm if 09:30 PST works or suggest an alternate time.

SLA / credits:
- We will record this incident per our internal SLA process. Once you accept the RCA, I will open the formal credit review with Finance and loop in Alex Martinez for sign-off.

Attachments: rca_draft_state-sync-20261123.pdf (customer RCA), token_snapshot_20261123.csv (evidence snapshot), verification_checklist_20261123.md (runbook for replay).

If you want any additional logs or a deeper appendix (stack traces, host-level I/O charts), I can attach those separately — they’re available but kept in the technical appendix to avoid overloading the customer-facing document.

Appreciate the partnership on this — we’ll keep working until you confirm verification.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Engineer, Redwood Inference
